newsitem.title: ROMANIA: SOCCER-PSG MUST THWART STEAUA MIDFIELD PLOT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PSG MUST THWART STEAUA MIDFIELD PLOT.

text.p: Paris St.Germain, one of the most consistently successful clubs in European soccer in recent years, must overcome Romanian champions Steaua Bucharest to join the continent's elite in the Champions' League.

PSG, a European semifinalist for the past five seasons, Cup Winners' Cup champions in 1996 and losing finalists last year, qualified for the European Cup as runners-up to Monaco in last season's French championship and travel to Bucharest for Wednesday's preliminary round first leg match.
They have had a solid start to this campaign, winning twice, although they had to come from 2-0 down to beat Auxerre 3-2 last week.

Florian Maurice and Italian striker Marco Simone have formed a good partnership up front while veteran defender Paul Le Guen, often criticised last season, has started well. But missing will be Brazilian star Leonardo, who is away on international duty.
Steaua will be without defender Adrian Matte, who was banned for three games by UEFA after being sent off for a bad tackle in Steaua's first preliminary round tie against CSKA Sofia last month.
Coach Mihai Stoichita called Matei's absence "a great loss" for his team and said he would probably be replaced by Tiberiu Csik.
Stoichita said his side had only "a long shot chance" but planned to swamp the midfield to limit PSG's ability to build patient attacks.
Steaua, European champions in 1986 and finalists in 1989, have won their first three league matches and are injury-free.

Steaua Bucharest - Zoltan Ritli; Laurentiu Reghecampf, Tiberiu Csik, Valeriu Rachita, Marius Baciu, Roland Nagy or Iulian Miu, Damian Militaru, Iosif Rotariu, Denis Serban, Marius Lacatus, Laurentiu Rosu.
PSG - Christophe Revault; Laurent Fournier, Alain Roche, Paul Le Guen, Didier Domi; Vincent Guerin, Bruno N'Gotty, Rai, Franck Gava; Florian Maurice, Marco Simone.
